# Wiki workflow

Treat the first message of a conversation as a request for a new page unless it is clearly something else. A question, a bug report or an explicit edit request is something else, and a question gets an answer and no file changes.

For a page request, draft the page, place it under `content/wiki/` in the section that fits its subject, and give it the frontmatter its sibling pages carry.
